automations.name: New enquiry follow-up
steps: Check contact eligibility and existing enrolment
Stop on reply, meeting or opt-out

automations.name: Proposal follow-through
steps: Check open opportunity and consent policy
Create a review task after 5 days
Stop when won, replied or opted out

automations.name: Renewal conversation
steps: Check renewal date and account owner
Stop on reply or completed renewal

automations.name: Positive call → follow-up
steps: Wait for a saved positive business outcome
Check contact preferences and call identity
If email is missing, wait for a valid email
Send the follow-up once for this call
Create a follow-up task and stop on reply
